title: session-load --paid runs real Haiku 5.5 sessions per arm, with a dry-run plan and a spend cap
goal: python3 _tools/benchmarks.py run session-load --paid starts, per arm, phase, session and rep, one claude -p of Haiku 5.5 (claude-haiku-5-5) with --max-budget-usd, in a throwaway clone whose settings are the arm's (A the project's, C without coord_hook and the querylog hooks, D kbcommon.NO_HOOKS), samples its process tree into the same rows as the replay with the model column set, and stops starting runs once --max-usd would be passed; session-load is in PLANNED, so --paid --dry-run prints the run count (234 runs for arms A,C,D, sessions 1,4,8, reps 3) and an estimate in US dollars and starts no claude

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, 'bin'); os.mkdir(B)
log = os.path.join(T, 'argv.log')
open(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 'w').write(
    '#!/bin/sh\nprintf "%s\\037" "$@" >> "' + log + '"\nprintf "\\036" >> "' + log + '"\n'
    'echo \'{"type":"result","subtype":"success","is_error":false,"total_cost_usd":0.001,'
    '"usage":{"input_tokens":10,"output_tokens":2}}\'\n')
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
def bench(*a):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'run', 'session-load', *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=1800)
d = bench('--paid', '--dry-run', '--arms', 'A,C,D', '--sessions', '1,4,8', '--reps', '3')
ran_dry = os.path.exists(log)
out = os.path.join(T, 'out.csv')
p = bench('--paid', '--arms', 'A,D', '--sessions', '1', '--reps', '1', '--out', out)
calls = [ln.split('\x1f') for ln in open(log).read().split('\x1e') if ln] if os.path.exists(log) else []
q = bench('--paid', '--arms', 'A', '--sessions', '1', '--reps', '3', '--max-usd', '0.0025', '--out', out)
capped = len([ln for ln in open(log).read().split('\x1e') if ln]) - len(calls) if os.path.exists(log) else 0
shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
assert d.returncode == 0, ('--paid --dry-run exit', d.returncode, d.stderr[-400:])
assert not ran_dry, 'the dry run started claude'
assert '234 runs' in d.stdout and '$' in d.stdout, ('the plan names no 234 runs or no estimate', d.stdout[-400:])
assert p.returncode == 0, ('--paid run exit', p.returncode, p.stderr[-400:])
assert calls and all('-p' in c and 'claude-haiku-5-5' in c and '--max-budget-usd' in c for c in calls), ('a paid run is not a capped Haiku 5.5 claude -p', calls)
off = [c for c in calls if any('disableAllHooks' in w for w in c)]
assert len(off) == len(calls) // 2 >= 2, ('arm D, and only arm D, runs with disableAllHooks', len(off), len(calls))
assert q.returncode == 0 and 1 <= capped <= 2, ('--max-usd does not stop new runs at the cap (6 runs without it)', q.returncode, capped)

gates.question: What --max-budget-usd does each paid session-load run get?
gates.reason: a Haiku 5.5 session of the two prompts cost 0.001 to 0.004 USD on the first real run, so 0.10 never binds a normal run and bounds a runaway one at 23 USD over the 234

gates.question: How does a paid session-load run stop starting sessions at the --max-usd cap, and what does the run exit with?
options: Start no group once the spend so far plus the group at the mean cost of the finished sessions of its phase would pass the cap; the first group always starts; later groups are left unstarted, a spend_stopped row names them, exit 0
As the pool: the same rule but exit 1 when sessions are left unstarted
gates.recommendation: Start no group once the spend so far plus the group at the mean cost of the finished sessions of its phase would pass the cap; the first group always starts; later groups are left unstarted, a spend_stopped row names them, exit 0
gates.reason: the item's check requires exit 0 at the cap
gates.answer: Start no group once the spend so far plus the group at the mean cost of the finished sessions of its phase would pass the cap; the first group always starts; later groups are left unstarted, a spend_stopped row names them, exit 0

gates.question: What prompt and tools does a session of each phase get?
options: Idle: reply with one word, no tool. Working: git status, one rag.py search, read 20 lines of README.md, one sentence; tools Read, git status and rag.py only
A longer scripted task with edits and a test run
gates.recommendation: Idle: reply with one word, no tool. Working: git status, one rag.py search, read 20 lines of README.md, one sentence; tools Read, git status and rag.py only
gates.reason: three tool calls fire the PreToolUse, PostToolUse and Stop hooks as the replay's working phase does, and cost a few cents at most
gates.answer: Idle: reply with one word, no tool. Working: git status, one rag.py search, read 20 lines of README.md, one sentence; tools Read, git status and rag.py only

gates.question: How does a paid run get the Claude Code version and the user's own settings out of its rows?
options: Bench subclass that runs a failing claude for its version probe, the version from the first session's init event, and claude -p with --setting-sources project,local
Leave the version probe and the user's settings as they are
gates.recommendation: Bench subclass that runs a failing claude for its version probe, the version from the first session's init event, and claude -p with --setting-sources project,local
gates.reason: bench_core is outside the touches and its probe would log a claude call that is no capped session; the user's own hooks and plugins are not the clone's cost

gates.question: Which rows does a session-load run with real sessions write, and what does --dry-run without them do?
options: The replay's rows (cpu_s, rss_peak_mb, rss_mean_mb, spawns_per_min per class and all, wall_s) plus run_failures and cost, the all CPU from wait4 and the class CPU from ps times; --dry-run without the flag exits 2
Only the replay's rows, and --dry-run without the flag runs the replay
gates.recommendation: The replay's rows (cpu_s, rss_peak_mb, rss_mean_mb, spawns_per_min per class and all, wall_s) plus run_failures and cost, the all CPU from wait4 and the class CPU from ps times; --dry-run without the flag exits 2
gates.reason: a dry run that starts the hook replay would break the plan's promise to start nothing
gates.answer: The replay's rows (cpu_s, rss_peak_mb, rss_mean_mb, spawns_per_min per class and all, wall_s) plus run_failures and cost, the all CPU from wait4 and the class CPU from ps times; --dry-run without the flag exits 2
